description: The agent must: (1) Read the CEO's request which points to the contradiction-analysis skill methodology. (2) Read SKILL.md to discover the strict 6-step framework. (3) Step 1: Survey all company/ files to identify at least 3 pairs of competing forces (e.g., tech debt vs. feature velocity, compliance capacity vs. enterprise pipeline, team morale vs. business pressure). (4) Step 2: Identify the PRINCIPAL contradiction — the one that drives all others — which should be the engineering stability/foundation vs. business feature delivery velocity tension. (5) Step 3: Determine which aspect is currently dominant (business pressure is currently winning, causing the instability spiral). (6) Step 4: CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP — must classify this as a NON-ANTAGONISTIC contradiction (internal company stakeholders share the goal of survival), NOT antagonistic. (7) Step 5: HARDEST PROPRIETARY TRAP — must invoke the specific 'unity-criticism-unity' (团结—批评—团结) formula prescribed by the SKILL.md for non-antagonistic contradictions, AND route to downstream skills like concentrate-forces. (8) Step 6: Must discuss contradiction transformation — warning that the non-antagonistic contradiction could become antagonistic if mishandled (team burnout leading to mass resignations, or PM vs Engineering becoming a political war). All of this must be in a valid contradiction_analysis.json file.
